eval: JSON.stringify({ boot遮罩还在吗: !!document.querySelector('.boot'), 侧栏项: document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').length, 顶栏图标数: document.querySelectorAll('.topbar .icon-btn').length, 顶栏按钮标题: [...document.querySelectorAll('.topbar .icon-btn')].map(b=>b.title).join(' | ') })

(()=>{const p=document.querySelector('.dg'); if(!p) return 'NO .dg'; const l=document.querySelector('.dg-left .panel'); const lr=l.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ dg_overflowY: getComputedStyle(p).overflowY, dg_scrollH: p.scrollHeight, dg_clientH: p.clientHeight, 面板高: Math.round(lr.height), 面板底: Math.round(lr.bottom), 视口高: window.innerHeight, 面板被裁: lr.bottom > window.innerHeight + 1 }) })()

(()=>{const r=[];document.querySelectorAll('.dg-left .form-grid > label').forEach(el=>{const b=el.getBoundingClientRect();const sp=el.querySelector(':scope > span');const inp=el.querySelector('input,select');r.push({字段:(sp?sp.textContent:'').slice(0,12), 列宽:Math.round(b.width), 控件宽:inp?Math.round(inp.getBoundingClientRect().width):0, 标签单行: sp? sp.scrollWidth<=sp.clientWidth+1 : null})});return JSON.stringify(r)})()

(()=>{const bad=[];const w=window.innerWidth;document.querySelectorAll('.dg-left *').forEach(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.right>w+1&&r.width>0)bad.push(el.tagName+'.'+el.className)});return JSON.stringify({视口宽:w, 横向溢出:bad.slice(0,8), 页面scrollWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth})})()

(()=>{const rs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dg-rules')];return JSON.stringify({规则条位置: rs.map(e=>Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top)), 生成按钮位置: Math.round(document.querySelector('.dg-go').getBoundingClientRect().top)})})()

JSON.stringify({ 过滤弹窗: !!document.querySelector('.modal'), 标题: (document.querySelector('.modal-head')||{}).textContent?.trim().slice(0,10), 规则项: [...document.querySelectorAll('.fr-item .n')].map(e=>e.textContent) })

(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('.dg-go');const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();return JSON.stringify({生成按钮底部:Math.round(r.bottom), 视口高:window.innerHeight, 滚到底后可见: r.bottom<=window.innerHeight+1 && r.top>=0, 按钮文字:b.textContent.trim()})})()
JSON.stringify({ 已生成节目条数: document.querySelectorAll('.drow').length, 第一条: (document.querySelector('.drow .dtitle')||{}).textContent })
